description: What a transaction costs right now on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, side by side: gas price, base and priority fee, USD cost of a native transfer, an ERC-20 transfer and a DEX swap (L2 L1-data fees included), the cheapest chain for each, and how each chain's gas price ranks against its own last 7 days of 10-minute samples, with the usually cheapest UTC hour. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

chains.description: Comma-separated subset: base, eth, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default all)

name: gas_compare
